Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, to be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 
in the above title block
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc
Shutdown the pump
Circuit breaker of pump 
 racked out
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Grease gun
Cleaning fluid, rags
Work to be carried out
Fill the coupling with grease
Take sample to check the thrust 
 bearing oil chemical and physical
